ActionDescriptions.ToAskModelViaBuffalyRuntime:
to ask a model with text image or video input
Preferred LLM action for text completion and multimodal understanding. Delegates to the active Buffaly runtime provider catalog.
prompt - optional primary text instruction.
systemPrompt - optional system instruction.
provider - optional provider token such as openai, xai, gemini, or anthropic.
model - optional model override validated by the runtime catalog.
reasoningLevel - optional canonical reasoning token.
inputPartsJson - optional JSON array of PascalCase content parts: Type text/image_url/video_url with Text/ImageUrl/VideoUrl/MimeType fields.
Does not support image or video generation.
ActionDescriptions.ToDownloadChatGptSharedConversationMessa:
to parse a chatgpt share link into json messages
Downloads a ChatGPT shared conversation page and extracts message blocks to JSON.
shareUrl - required absolute ChatGPT share URL (https://chatgpt.com/s/...).
outputDirectory - optional directory for output files; defaults to current project directory when empty.
outputFileName - optional JSON output file name; defaults to chatgpt_shared_messages.json when empty.
Returns JSON with output paths, chunk count, message count, and extracted messages.
Notes: extraction is best-effort and depends on payload shape exposed by the share page.
ActionDescriptions.ToGenerateTextToSpeechAudio:
to create a text to speech audio artifact
Generate a provider-backed text-to-speech MP3 artifact under the current session artifacts/audio directory.
text - required text to synthesize.
outputFileName - optional file name; output is always written under artifacts/audio and forced to .mp3.
provider - optional provider token; empty uses the active/default TTS provider.
model - optional provider model; empty uses the provider default.
voice - optional voice; empty uses the provider/model default.
instructions - optional provider-specific speech instructions.
ActionDescriptions.ToGenerateTextToSpeechVoiceSamples:
to create text to speech samples for voices
Generate one provider-backed text-to-speech MP3 artifact per requested voice under the current session artifacts/audio directory.
text - required text to synthesize.
provider - optional provider token; empty uses the active/default TTS provider.
model - optional provider model; empty uses the provider default.
voicesCsv - optional comma-separated voice list; empty uses all supported voices for the provider/model.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBuffalyProviderModelCatalog:
to show available runtime provider model options
Returns the authoritative provider catalog: available providers, transports, exact model names, default selection, and reasoning level options. Use this before ToSetBuffalySessionModelSelection; modelName must be an exact ModelName from this catalog for the selected provider/transport.

to get current buffaly runtime provider selection

ActionDescriptions.ToGetCurrentBuffalyRuntimeContext:
to get my parent session key

ActionDescriptions.ToListTextToSpeechVoices:
to list provider text to speech models and voices
List provider-backed text-to-speech providers, models, and voices from the active Buffaly runtime catalog without calling external provider APIs.
provider - optional provider token such as openai, gemini, or xai.
model - optional model token to filter voices.
ActionDescriptions.ToPrepareComprehensiveCodingInvestigatio:
to assemble a difficult coding handoff prompt
Prepare a complete markdown brief for a difficult coding/debugging problem using evidence, code locations, and targeted snippets. Build incrementally and return final markdown for user handoff to model of choice.
ActionDescriptions.ToSetBuffalySessionModelSelection:
to change a buffaly session provider model
Sets the provider, exact catalog ModelName, and optional reasoning level for an existing session through backend provider-catalog validation. Before choosing or changing a model, call ToGetBuffalyProviderModelCatalog and pass only an exact ModelName returned for the selected provider/transport; do not invent, alias, normalize, or guess model names. Non-catalog model names are rejected.
